newsitem.title: UK: Coats Viyella rises in weak textile sector.
newsitem.headline: Coats Viyella rises in weak textile sector.

text.p: Shares in Coats Viyella Plc pushed higher on Tuesday after a company forecast of stable second-half earnings prompted buyers to enter the market for the first time in nearly two months.
"They have fallen a long way and were due for a bounce up," a market maker said.
By 1554 GMT, Coats Viyella, which also predicted some improvement in its 1997 underlying trading performance, was up 6-1/2p at 128-1/2.
Shares in Coats Viyella have been in a nearly uninterrupted downward trend since October 2 when they closed at 164 pence.
The shares had been briefly boosted just before that date following encouraging first-half results.
Coats' statement today helped it to shrug off weakness in the rest of the textile sector which was hit by a profit warning from Sherwood Group Plc.
Courtaulds Textiles shares were down 10p at 221 by 1558 GMT, Dewhirst Group Plc was down 2-1/2p at 180 and Sirdar Plc was down 6-1/2p at 63-1/2.
Sherwood, which was down 17p at 41-1/2, said there were indications of "disappointing" sales and profits in its garment division in the final quarter of the year.
